_README: Contenido editorial pre-lanzamiento. SOLO hechos confirmados por Rockstar/Take-Two o prensa mayor. Cada pagina distingue explicitamente lo confirmado de lo que no lo esta. No agregar nada basado en filtraciones.

items.title: GTA 6 Release Date: November 19, 2026
items.description: Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Confirmed date, pre-load time, and what Rockstar has actually said.

sections.p: Grand Theft Auto VI releases on November 19, 2026. The date is confirmed by Rockstar Games, and Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has publicly reaffirmed it, stating there is no further delay planned. The game was previously delayed from earlier windows, so this is the date that currently stands.

Pre-loading opens at local midnight on November 12, 2026 — seven days before launch. This applies to digital pre-orders and to boxed copies whose codes have been redeemed. If you want to play at launch rather than wait on a download, this is the date that matters.
The game launches on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, with PS5 Pro enhancements. There is no PC version announced. See our PC version page for what Rockstar has and has not said.

Anything not confirmed by Rockstar directly is marked as unconfirmed on this site. Leaked footage and datamined files circulating online have not been verified, and we do not publish them as fact. Vehicle stats, mission lists and business payouts do not exist yet in any verified form — anyone publishing them today is guessing.

items.title: GTA 6 Price and Editions: Standard vs Ultimate
items.description: GTA 6 costs $79.99 standard and $99.99 ultimate. Full breakdown of both editions, regional pricing, pre-order bonuses and the upgrade path.

sections.p: Rockstar has confirmed two editions. The Standard Edition costs $79.99 (€75 / £64) and the Ultimate Edition costs $99.99 (€94 / £80). That is a $20 gap between them.

If you buy Standard and change your mind, you can upgrade to Ultimate afterwards by paying the $20 difference. You are not locked out by buying the cheaper edition first, which makes Standard the lower-risk choice if you are undecided.

Purchases made before November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack. Digital pre-orders also include one free month of GTA+, Rockstar's subscription service. Boxed pre-orders do not include the GTA+ month.

The $79.99 standard price is above the $69.99 that has been typical for major console releases. Rockstar has not published a full contents breakdown of what separates the two editions beyond the pre-order items, so if the Ultimate extras matter to you, it is worth waiting for that detail before committing.

items.title: Is GTA 6 Coming to PC?
items.description: GTA 6 has no announced PC release. What Rockstar has actually said, what the studio's history suggests, and why no date exists yet.

sections.p: There is no announced PC version of GTA 6. Rockstar's own launch materials mention PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S only. The company has not announced a PC release date, and has not confirmed that a PC version is in development.

Rockstar has historically released PC versions of mainline Grand Theft Auto titles later than the console release, sometimes by a year or more. That pattern is a reasonable basis for expecting a PC version eventually — but a pattern is not an announcement, and we are not going to present it as one.

sections.h: What this means if you only play on PC
sections.p: As things stand, there is no date to plan around. Anyone publishing a specific PC release date today is inventing it. If Rockstar announces one, this page gets updated.

items.title: Does GTA 6 Have Online Multiplayer at Launch?
items.description: Rockstar has not confirmed a GTA 6 online mode at launch. Exactly what has and has not been announced about multiplayer.

sections.p: Rockstar has not announced a GTA 6 version of GTA Online. There is no roadmap for multiplayer modes and no timetable for when, or whether, that side of the series connects to the new world. This is one of the biggest open questions about the game.

sections.h: The GTA+ detail that confuses people
sections.p: Digital pre-orders include a free month of GTA+, and GTA+ is the subscription tied to GTA Online. Some coverage has read this as evidence that GTA 6 Online exists at launch. It is not evidence — GTA+ already applies to the existing GTA Online in GTA V, which is the straightforward reading.

In GTA V, the online mode is where the business and money systems live, and where most players spent most of their hours. Whether GTA 6 ships with an equivalent at launch, later, or in a different shape changes what the game is for a large part of the audience. We will update this page when Rockstar says something concrete, and not before.

items.title: GTA 6 Setting and Characters: Leonida, Vice City, Jason and Lucia
items.description: GTA 6 is set in the state of Leonida with Vice City at its centre, starring dual protagonists Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.

sections.p: GTA 6 is set in the fictional state of Leonida, which Rockstar describes as home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond. This is the first mainline entry to give the player a full state rather than a single city and its outskirts.
The game has dual protagonists: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Lucia is the first female playable protagonist in a mainline Grand Theft Auto game.
Rockstar has released official screenshots showing named locations including Mount Kalaga National Park, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Grassrivers, alongside Vice City itself.

The full map layout is not official. Every detailed GTA 6 map circulating online is fan reconstruction built from trailer analysis and leaked material, not a Rockstar release. The voice cast has also not been confirmed, despite widely repeated fan casting. We do not publish either as fact.

items.title: About Leonida HQ
items.description: Who runs this site, where the data comes from, and how to submit a correction.

sections.p: An independent, fan-made reference site for Grand Theft Auto VI. We publish databases, calculators and guides, and we label every data point as either confirmed or unconfirmed.

We do not publish unverified data as fact. The game is not out. Any site showing you vehicle top speeds or business payouts today is making them up. When the game launches and real data exists, this site fills in fast — and every figure will say where it came from.
If something here is wrong, tell us and we will fix it. Accuracy is the only reason anyone would come back to a site like this.

This site is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. All game trademarks are the property of their owners. We use them only to describe the game this site covers.

items.title: GTA 6 File Size: Rockstar Has Not Published One
items.description: How many GB is GTA 6? Rockstar has not published an install size. What is official, where the circulating numbers come from, and what to plan for.

sections.p: Rockstar has not published a file size for GTA 6. As of late September 2026 there is no official GB figure for PS5 or Xbox Series X|S. Every number you see in a headline is an estimate made by someone outside Rockstar.

Two things are confirmed that affect your storage. Pre-loading opens on November 12, 2026, a week before launch, so the download can finish before release day. And the boxed edition is a code in a box, not a disc with the game on it, so physical buyers download the whole game too (reported by GamesRadar+). See our release date page for pre-load details.

GamesRadar+ published an estimate of at least 120–130 GB, based on GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 sitting around 100–110 GB today. That is a guess from comparison, and they say so. Larger figures circulating on social media and aggregator sites have no Rockstar source behind them. None of these numbers are wrong to discuss; they are wrong to present as fact.

The install size on each console, the size of a day-one patch, and whether the two platforms differ. When the figure appears on the PlayStation Store or Microsoft Store listing, or Rockstar publishes it, this page will carry it with the source. Until then, the honest answer is that the number does not exist publicly.

items.title: Does GTA 6 Have Microtransactions?
items.description: Rockstar says GTA 6 has no real-money purchases in its single-player game at launch. Who said it, where, and what the answer does not cover, including Online.

sections.p: No, not in the single-player game at launch, according to Rockstar. You pay for the game once and it does not ask for more real money inside the story mode.

Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson answered the question during a press visit to the studio in Edinburgh. The hosts of the Kinda Funny Gamecast reported his answer as “no monetization” when they asked about spending real money in the game. GameSpot reported it on August 27, 2026. Note that this is a verbal answer relayed by the press, not a written policy from Rockstar.

No microtransactions does not mean everything is in the base game. Some single-player content is exclusive to the Ultimate Edition, including several in-game shops and side missions, as GamesRadar+ reported. You can move from Standard to Ultimate by paying the $20 difference. Our editions page has the prices.

sections.h: What the answer does not cover
sections.p: It covers the single-player game at launch. It says nothing about a future online mode, which Rockstar has not announced (see online multiplayer), or about paid expansions later. GTA Online for GTA V, which does sell in-game currency, keeps running. If Rockstar announces an online mode for GTA 6, its monetization is a separate question that is still unanswered.

items.title: GTA 6 Radio Stations: None Confirmed Yet
items.description: Rockstar has not named a single GTA 6 radio station. What it has said about in-game radio, how the album relates, and why station lists online are unofficial.

sections.p: Rockstar has not confirmed any GTA 6 radio station by name, host or genre. Lists of stations you see online do not come from Rockstar.

On September 17, 2026, at the end of its post announcing GTA VI: The Album, Rockstar teased the “next evolution of in-game radio” and asked fans to stay tuned for details about the game's music and its dynamic score (reported by GameSpot). That is the full extent of the official statement: radio exists and more details are coming.

sections.h: The album is not the radio
sections.p: The 34-track album is original music made for the game. It is reasonable to expect those songs to be heard in-game, but Rockstar has not said which station plays what, or whether licensed classics sit alongside them the way they did in earlier games.

Reports that specific celebrities will host stations have circulated for months; GameSpot describes them as rumors. We do not list station names drawn from leaked footage, and we do not treat background signage in trailers as proof that a station is playable. This page gets a full list once Rockstar publishes one.

items.title: Rockstar's Mod Guidelines Explained Ahead of GTA 6
items.description: Rockstar updated its mod guidelines in September 2026. What the rules ban, how mods can be monetized, and what they mean for GTA 6 given there is no PC version.

sections.p: In September 2026 Rockstar published updated mod guidelines on its official site. They apply to all Rockstar games and they are strict: no new story content set in Rockstar's continuity, no mixing of assets between Rockstar games, no ports, and no money made from mods outside Rockstar's own platform.

According to the published text, as quoted by Kotaku and GamesRadar+, mods must not expand or modify Rockstar's storylines, missions or characters; must not combine maps, characters or assets from one Rockstar game into another; and must not make a game run on platforms where Rockstar has not released it. They also bar third-party IP, reuse of Rockstar voice performances, and using a real person's voice or likeness without written permission.

Mods must be non-commercial unless monetized through Rockstar's official Creator Platform, which the guidelines name as the only licensed route. Multiplayer modding is likewise limited to that platform or to direct licences from Rockstar. The page also rules out real-money gambling, loot boxes and crypto schemes in mods.

sections.h: What it means for GTA 6 right now
sections.p: Very little in practice, for now. GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only, and no PC version has been announced, so there is no way to mod it yet. The rules tell you what Rockstar will object to once a PC version exists. How strictly they will be enforced is something Rockstar has not said.

items.title: Was Generative AI Used to Make GTA 6?
items.description: Rockstar says GTA 6 was made without generative AI. Who said it and when, what the New York Times reported, and the limits of what that statement covers.

sections.p: No, according to Rockstar. The studio says generative AI was not used to make GTA 6.

During press visits to Rockstar North in August 2026, the Kinda Funny Gamecast hosts asked co-studio head Rob Nelson directly whether AI was in the game. They reported his answer as “no AI.” Separately, the New York Times feature published on August 27, 2026 reported that Rockstar emphasized the game's human-made craft. GameSpot covered both the same day.

sections.h: The detail that backs it up
sections.p: Per the same New York Times report, Rockstar said the game has over 600,000 animations, compared with 55,000 in GTA V and 300,000 in Red Dead Redemption 2. That is a Rockstar-provided figure, not an independent count.

sections.h: What the statement does not cover
sections.p: It is a verbal answer relayed by journalists, not a written company policy. It refers to making the game, and does not address tools used after launch or any future online mode. If Rockstar publishes a formal position, this page will quote it.

items.title: GTA 6 Frame Rate: 30fps on Console at Launch
items.description: GTA 6 runs at 30fps on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S at launch. Who at Rockstar confirmed it, what was said about a performance mode, and what remains unknown.

sections.p: 30 frames per second on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S at launch. A 60fps performance mode has not been announced.

The Netflix Extended Look on August 27, 2026 showed PS5 footage running at 30fps. Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson then told Portuguese outlet Flow Games that the game runs at 30fps and that further options may be added in the future, as reported by GamesRadar+ on August 28.

“May be added in the future” is not an announcement of a performance mode, and it is not a denial. Headlines claiming 60fps is coming, or that it is ruled out, go further than Rockstar did. Rockstar has also not said what, if anything, the PS5 Pro changes about frame rate.

Whether a performance mode arrives in a post-launch update, what the PS5 Pro version runs at, and the resolution targets on each console. For PC, there is no announced version at all, so no PC frame-rate information exists.

items.title: How Big Is the GTA 6 Map? What Rockstar Said
items.description: GTA 6's map is about three times the size of Red Dead Redemption 2's, per Rockstar. What that figure means, where each comparison came from and what is unknown.

sections.p: Rockstar says the map of Leonida is roughly three times the size of Red Dead Redemption 2's. It has not given a measurement in square miles or kilometres.

The three-times-RDR2 figure came from Rockstar in the New York Times feature published alongside the Netflix Extended Look on August 27, 2026 (reported by GamesRadar+). Further comparisons — about twice the size of GTA V's map, and Vice City itself twice the size of Los Santos — were attributed to Rob Nelson but relayed second-hand by a YouTuber who attended a studio preview, as Kotaku noted. Treat those as reported, not as a published Rockstar figure.

sections.h: Why there is no km² number
sections.p: A ratio is not a measurement. Any exact area you see online was calculated by someone outside Rockstar, often from fan-made maps built from trailers. We do not publish those as fact, and the full official map has not been released. See setting and characters for locations Rockstar has named.
Rob Nelson has said his own playthrough of the main campaign took about 80 hours (GamesRadar+). That is one developer's run through the story, not an official completion time.

items.title: GTA VI: The Album — Tracks, Date and Formats
items.description: GTA VI: The Album has 34 original tracks from Atlantic Records and Rockstar, out November 19, 2026. Confirmed artists, formats, prices and what it is not.

sections.p: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album is a collection of 34 original tracks made for the game, produced with Atlantic Records. Rockstar announced it on September 17, 2026, and the full album is set for November 19, 2026, the same day as the game.

Six tracks were released on announcement day. Confirmed contributors include Travis Scott, Rauw Alejandro, Keith Richards, Morgan Wallen, and Yung Lean, whose track features Future and Metro Boomin. The rest of the tracklist has not been published.

Beyond streaming, the album is available to pre-order on CD (about $20), as a standard double vinyl (about $50, with retailer-specific colours) and as a $125 limited-edition vinyl, per GamesRadar+. Those are US list prices at announcement; availability of the limited edition may change.
It is not a list of radio stations. Rockstar has separately teased the “next evolution of in-game radio” without naming any station. See GTA 6 radio stations for what is and is not known.

items.title: GTA 6 Leaks: How Rockstar and Take-Two Responded
items.description: What Rockstar and Take-Two officially did about the August 2026 GTA 6 leaks: the statement, the takedowns and the court subpoenas. No leaked material is shown.

sections.p: Starting in mid-August 2026, unreleased GTA 6 footage was posted online without Rockstar's permission. Rockstar and Take-Two responded with copyright takedowns, court subpoenas to identify those responsible, and a public statement on August 26. This page covers only that response. We do not show, describe or link to leaked material.

Accounts that reposted the footage received DMCA takedown notices within days, as GamesRadar+ reported on August 18. Take-Two then asked a US federal court for subpoenas requiring Microsoft and Discord to hand over information that could identify the people behind the leaks, according to Variety.

On August 26, 2026, the day before the Netflix Extended Look, Rockstar posted a statement on social media calling the leaks “heartbreaking for our team” and apologizing for how long the game has taken. It asked players to wait and experience the game themselves on November 19 (quoted by GamesRadar+).

sections.h: Why we do not cover the leaked content
sections.p: Leaked footage is unverified by definition, may show an old build, and is subject to active copyright claims. Nothing on this site is based on it, including as unconfirmed material. The first official gameplay was the Netflix Extended Look on August 27; everything we publish as fact traces back to Rockstar, Take-Two or a named major outlet.
